twofactor.title: Two-factor authentication
twofactor.heading: Two-factor authentication
twofactor.mandatory: Your account has admin rights, so two-factor authentication is required and cannot be turned off.
twofactor.start.intro: Confirm your password to start. You need an authenticator app on your phone.
twofactor.codes.heading: Recovery codes
twofactor.codes.warning: Save these codes now. They are shown only once and each works one time.
twofactor.codeOrRecovery: Code from your app or a recovery code
twofactor.regen.heading: New recovery codes
twofactor.disable.heading: Turn off two-factor authentication
twofactor.disable.intro: Afterwards your password alone is enough to sign in. Your other sessions end.
